title: fix(store): correct client account-deletion instructions (T2)
body:
## Summary

HUNT-10-124, agent 124 — **T2** (public account-deletion instructions; no deletion behavior change).

Fix **U-HUNT10-1**: a client following the public account-deletion page looks for “Data & Privacy → Delete my account,” but current mobile Settings uses **Account → Delete account**.

- Correct the client section/button names in the public page.
- Preserve the coach's **Settings → Privacy & Data → Delete my account** path, no-app email route, reauthentication and deletion/grace behavior.
- Update the existing rendered-page contract, explanatory comments, module README and last-reviewed date.

Mobile evidence: [`SettingsScreen.tsx` at reviewed main](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/321274f36939e25a2cdf19ec2b840bda4b395967/src/screens/client/SettingsScreen.tsx#L174-L204); [coach path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/321274f36939e25a2cdf19ec2b840bda4b395967/src/screens/coach/settings/DangerZone.tsx). [Public page](https://app.trygrowthproject.com/help/delete-account).

## Failing-first proof

The existing Jest rendered-page test was corrected before source in commit `4a3bb80a`. A dependency-free Node source-copy contract, run through `heavy.sh` before implementation, produced **1 client-path failure / 1 coach-path pass**, then **2 passes** after the fix. The exact logs and probe are saved in `ops/aud-124/HUNT-10-124/delete-path-{before,after}.log` and `delete-path-contract.cjs`.

Shared backend dependencies are not ready, so this is explicitly **source-copy proof, not a local Jest runtime run**. The PR's normal CI runs the existing full Jest renderer coverage, lint and typecheck/build checks. No second extra ci-lane, local full suite or build.

## Owner steps

No dashboard change is required to make this copy match the app. Keep Play Console's data-deletion URL **https://app.trygrowthproject.com/help/delete-account**; after the owner-authorized normal release, verify the page gives **Account → Delete account** for clients. This agent neither merges nor deploys.

No account/deletion API, server flag, native config, credentials, lockfile, provider call, production write, signup, spend or deployment changed.
